films.ov: Unemployed Antonio is elated when he finally finds work hanging posters around war-torn Rome. However on his first day, his bicycle—essential to his work—gets stolen. His job is doomed unless he can find the thief. With the help of his son, Antonio combs the city, becoming desperate for justice.

When elderly pensioner Umberto Domenico Ferrari returns to his boarding house from a protest calling for a hike in old-age pensions, his landlady demands her 15,000-lire rent by the end of the month or he and his small dog will be turned out onto the street. Unable to get the money in time, Umberto fakes illness to get sent to a hospital, giving his beloved dog to the landlady's pregnant and abandoned maid for temporary safekeeping.

Once upon a time a wise and kind old woman discovers a baby in her cabbage patch. She brings up the child and, when she dies, the boy, Totò, enters an orphanage. Totò leaves the orphanage a happy young man, and looks for work in post-war Milan. He ends up with the homeless and organizes them to build a shanty town in a vacant lot. But when greedy developers threaten the community’s land, Totò will need all the help he can get in order to find an impossible way out.
Three tales of very different women using their sexuality as a means to getting what they want.

In 1930s Italy, a wealthy Jewish family tries to maintain their privileged lifestyle, hosting friends for tennis and parties at their villa. As anti-Semitism intensifies under Fascism, they must ultimately face the horrors of the Holocaust.

Two shoeshine boys in postwar Rome, Italy save up to buy a horse, but their involvement as dupes in a burglary lands them in juvenile prison; the experience take a devastating toll on their friendship.

facts: Worked with the screenwriter Cesare Zavattini.
Cast a factory worker as the father in Bicycle Thieves.
Was a matinee idol as an actor before he directed.
lists: Won the top prize at Cannes for Miracle in Milan (1951, shared).
3 films in the TSPDT 1,000 Greatest Films; the highest is Bicycle Thieves at #15.
3 films received votes in the 2022 Sight and Sound critics' poll; the highest is Bicycle Thieves at #34.
On the House of Tabula film studies watchlist: Bicycle Thieves.
Won the Oscar for international feature with Shoeshine (1947), Bicycle Thieves (1949), Yesterday, Today and Tomorrow (1964), The Garden of the Finzi-Continis (1971).
1 film in Cahiers du cinéma's 100 films for an ideal cinémathèque (2008): Bicycle Thieves (#86=).
1 film in Cahiers du cinéma's top 10 of the year, 1951 to 1951.

films.ov: In Italy, Checco Dal Monte manages a troupe of traveling performers with plenty of heart but minimal talent. At a small town engagement, he encounters the starry-eyed, gorgeous Lily Antonelli, and hires her as a dancer on the show. Vivacious Lily quickly sells out crowds and earns the resentment of Checco's mistress, Melina Amour, but the fledgling performer has far bigger ambitions and soon sets her sights on a higher-profile role.
When a good-natured factory supervisor living in Milan with his Northern wife returns to his native Sicily, a decades' old oath forces him to fulfill a nightmarish obligation.
Six vignettes explore love and desire in Rome, from prostitution and heartache to unwed motherhood and the male gaze.
A married Roman landscape architect starts an affair with a young woman who might be a shadow from his past.

In order to convince Raimonda, a wealthy noble woman, to finance his project for a holiday resort, Saverio gets engaged to Clotilde, her mentally-disturbed and sex-obsessed adolescent daughter. He plans to have her kidnapped and raped by an accomplice so she won't be a virgin anymore and he'll have...
At age 50, tax inspector Emerenziano decides to settle down and aims to the three Tettamanzi sisters, who, though not young or pretty by any means, have recently inherited a large amount of money.

facts: Co-founded the Cineteca Italiana in Milan with Luigi Comencini.

films.ov: During the Cold War, the World Chess Championship clashed complete opposites - personal and political.

facts: Michel Piccoli plays the Soviet champion.
The film is loosely inspired by the Karpov–Korchnoi matches.
lists: Won the Oscar for international feature with Dangerous Moves (1984).

films.ov: Once a young woman gets a man to fall in love with her, he must prove himself financially stable and meet her dowry requirements.
Pasquale and Maria, husband and wife, live in a palace supposedly haunted by ghosts and pay no rent. When Pasquale finds some food in the cupboard he thinks the ghosts are at work.

A young girl comes to prison and experiences the entire prison subculture. The inmates she befriends vary from big tough dangerous dames to smaller submissive ladies who are totally lost in prison life.
A lovely, incisive portrait of adolescents in the crowded San Giovanni quarter of Rome during the last years of WWII.

facts: Two Cents Worth of Hope cast non-professionals from a village near Naples.
Won the Golden Lion for his Romeo and Juliet in 1954.
lists: Won the top prize at Cannes for Two Cents Worth of Hope (1952, shared).

films.t: We All Loved Each Other So Much
films.ov: Three partisans bound by a strong friendship return home after the war, but the clash with everyday reality puts a strain on their bond.
Two neighbours — a persecuted journalist and a resigned housewife — forge a strong bond on the day of Adolf Hitler's historic 1938 visit to Rome.

Giacinto lives with his wife, their ten children and various other family members in a shack on the hills of Rome. Some time ago he has lost his left eye while at work, and got a consistent sum of money from the insurance company, which he keeps hidden from the rest of the family. His whole life is...

films.t: A Drama of Jealousy (and other things)
films.ov: Construction worker Oreste and young fiancee Adelaide meet Nello, a cook in a pizzeria. This love triangle often goes to communist rallies, and enjoys the filthy beaches of Ostia. Will the hostile environment pave a way to jealousy?

A collection of dark-humoured vignettes, including tales of a cardinal with a liberal congregation, a motorist and a hitchhiker, mentally challenged tramps, parents contemplating their daughter's participation in a pornographic film, and a conniving husband.

A terrace in Rome is a recurrent gathering place for a group of friends from the intellectual upper-class. Their lives unfold and intertwine, as they struggle with aging, disappointment and disillusion, until they are left with the realization that their generation, and everything it stood for, is...

films.ov: Two soldiers from opposite sides get stuck between the front lines in the same trench. The UN is asked to free them and both sides agree on a ceasefire, but will they stick to it?

After suffering a personal tragedy, and desperate for justice, Jacob Kanon, a veteran New York City police detective, embarks on the search for a twisted killer who is leaving a bloody trail of elaborate murders across Europe.
The wife of a photojournalist sets out to discover why he came home from a recent assignment without his colleague.

Three sisters who share a connection to a violent childhood incident reunite for the chance to come to terms with their past.
